inspiration.observed_pattern: A parent report uses correlated scalar subqueries for ordered fallback values and for a distinct ordered GROUP_CONCAT over a derived UNION of two filtered credit paths, with COALESCE/NULLIF precedence and nullable deletion guards.
inspiration.mysql_mariadb_translation: Reauthored as a media release credit summary. Blank release titles fall back to the first non-cover part title; writer names are collected from part credits and release-level credits through a correlated UNION-derived relation, normalized with NULLIF/COALESCE/TRIM, deduplicated and ordered inside GROUP_CONCAT, and filtered for nonblank names. The source comics schema, names, identifiers, and export placeholders are not copied.

fixture_notes: Release 101 uses its first non-cover part title because its stored title is blank. Its duplicate Ada credit appears through both part and release paths but is emitted once; deleted credits, non-writer roles, and cover-only parts are excluded. Draft release 103 is filtered.
determinism_notes: Release IDs, part sequence numbers, role names, credit IDs, normalized names, filters, aggregate ordering, and final ordering are fixed; no clocks, randomness, sleeps, or concurrent schedules are used.
setup: CREATE TABLE media_releases (release_id INT PRIMARY KEY, release_title VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, release_status VARCHAR(16) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE media_parts (part_id INT PRIMARY KEY, release_id INT NOT NULL, sequence_no INT NULL, part_title VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE media_people (person_id INT PRIMARY KEY, person_name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE media_roles (role_id INT PRIMARY KEY, role_name VARCHAR(32) NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE part_credits (credit_id INT PRIMARY KEY, part_id INT NOT NULL, role_id INT NOT NULL, person_id INT NULL, credited_as VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, credit_name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, deleted TINYINT NULL)

CREATE TABLE release_credits (credit_id INT PRIMARY KEY, release_id INT NOT NULL, role_id INT NOT NULL, person_id INT NULL, credited_as VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, credit_name VARCHAR(64) NOT NULL, deleted TINYINT NULL)

steps.sql: SELECT r.release_id, COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(r.release_title), ''), (SELECT p.part_title FROM media_parts AS p WHERE p.release_id = r.release_id AND (p.sequence_no IS NULL OR p.sequence_no <> 0) ORDER BY p.sequence_no ASC LIMIT 1)) AS display_title, (SELECT GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT names.credited_name ORDER BY names.credited_name ASC SEPARATOR ', ') FROM (SELECT mp.release_id AS release_id, TRIM(COALESCE(NULLIF(pc.credited_as, ''), NULLIF(pc.credit_name, ''), pe.person_name)) AS credited_name FROM media_parts AS mp INNER JOIN part_credits AS pc ON pc.part_id = mp.part_id INNER JOIN media_roles AS mr ON mr.role_id = pc.role_id LEFT JOIN media_people AS pe ON pe.person_id = pc.person_id WHERE (mp.sequence_no IS NULL OR mp.sequence_no <> 0) AND mr.role_name = 'writer' AND (pc.deleted = 0 OR pc.deleted IS NULL) UNION SELECT rc.release_id AS release_id, TRIM(COALESCE(NULLIF(rc.credited_as, ''), NULLIF(rc.credit_name, ''), pe.person_name)) AS credited_name FROM release_credits AS rc INNER JOIN media_roles AS mr ON mr.role_id = rc.role_id LEFT JOIN media_people AS pe ON pe.person_id = rc.person_id WHERE mr.role_name = 'writer' AND (rc.deleted = 0 OR rc.deleted IS NULL)) AS names WHERE names.release_id = r.release_id AND NULLIF(names.credited_name, '') IS NOT NULL) AS writer_names FROM media_releases AS r WHERE r.release_status = 'published' ORDER BY r.release_id ASC

checks.sql: SELECT release_id, release_title, release_status FROM media_releases ORDER BY release_id
SELECT part_id, release_id, sequence_no, part_title FROM media_parts ORDER BY part_id
SELECT credit_id, part_id, role_id, person_id, credited_as, credit_name, deleted FROM part_credits ORDER BY credit_id
SELECT credit_id, release_id, role_id, person_id, credited_as, credit_name, deleted FROM release_credits ORDER BY credit_id
